question: Should photoscrawl classify allow arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoint URLs for image classification, and if so how should non-local image-byte transmission be recorded and disclosed?
rationale: The repository policy allows opt-in cloud/model calls only when the assets or derived thumbnails leaving the machine are identified, so the endpoint behavior needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Require guard or disclosure
options.body: Keep the LM Studio path, but require loopback validation or evidence/docs that accurately mark non-local endpoint transmission before merge.

options.title: Accept arbitrary endpoints
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally treat --local-model-url as advanced opt-in, but should own the privacy wording and evidence semantics.

options.title: Split scope
options.body: Ask for a narrower classifier PR and review the new export command separately as its own media retrieval surface.

recommendation.title: Require guard or disclosure
recommendation.body: Keep the LM Studio path, but require loopback validation or evidence/docs that accurately mark non-local endpoint transmission before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 introduced the local model classifier and is the strongest history signal for the local-model privacy boundary.
